title: Salas's 2.5-hour AARO interview

tellings.quote: my case, I gave them a 2 and 1/2 hour talk. I I gave them documents to support what I was saying.

plain: A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas, who says a UFO once shut down ten nuclear missiles, says he sat with AARO, the Pentagon office that now studies unexplained aerial reports, for two and a half hours to lay out his case. He tells Michels he also handed them documents to back up what he said, which matters to him because it means the office had his evidence firsthand.
